metadata.displayWarning: The treaty legally fixes the boundary axis at 141 degrees west longitude, but its exact placement on a modern geodetic globe is shown with medium display confidence until a source-backed datum transformation is registered. The 61–69 N endpoints are conservative interior display clips, not treaty endpoints.
metadata.note: Treaty-defined meridian rendered only over the conservative interior interval 61°–69° N. No southeastern panhandle or terminal intersection is inferred.
